description: Rank the same index under several ranking versions side by side Rank the same index under several ranking versions side by side. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/mcp_registry/servers/compare/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/mcp_registry/servers/compare/
Rank the same index under several ranking versions side by side. With exactly two versions the response includes per-server rank deltas, the review surface for promoting a new ranking version.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; versions (query) — Comma-separated ranking versions to compare (2+).
Optional: limit (query) — Rows per arm (default 20, max 100).; search (query) — Optional text filter applied to every arm.

context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/mcp_registry/servers/discover/
Given a task, return the MCP servers most likely to do it, each with its rank rationale, real usage signal where we measure it, and ready-to-run connection instructions. One call is everything an agent needs to go from a task to a connected server.
Required: intent (query) — What the agent is trying to do, in natural language.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: limit (query) — Candidates to return (default 5, max 20).; version (query) — Ranking version to rank candidates by.

context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/mcp_registry/servers/
List registry servers ordered by static rank under the chosen ranking version.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: limit (query) — Number of results to return per page.; measured_only (query) — Only servers with real MCP Analytics signal.; offset (query) — The initial index from which to return the results.; search (query) — Free-text query matched against server names, descriptions, and tool names.; version (query) — Ranking version ordering the results; defaults to the current default version.

GET /api/projects/{project_id}/mcp_registry/servers/measured_projects/
Which projects feed MCP Analytics signal into the index, and how much each contributes. Staff only, because it reports across every project rather than the one in the route: it answers whether the measured layer has enough coverage to rank on.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
